description: This file contains utility functions for constructing support and sales contact URLs for Mattermost, including integration with Zendesk support forms and Mattermost contact sales links.

methods.name: buildZendeskSupportForm
methods.description: Constructs a Zendesk support form URL with specified form type and prefilled fields.

methods.name: goToCloudSupportForm
methods.description: Opens a new window with the Zendesk support form URL for cloud support, prefilled with provided details.

methods.name: getCloudSupportLink
methods.description: Returns a URL for the Zendesk cloud support form with prefilled details.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string to base64 format.

methods.name: buildMMURL
methods.description: Builds a Mattermost contact sales URL with encoded user details.

methods.name: goToMattermostContactSalesForm
methods.description: Opens a new window with the Mattermost contact sales URL.

methods.name: getCloudContactSalesLink
methods.description: Returns a Mattermost contact sales URL with encoded user details.
